info.title: Vertex Markets API
info.description: Production-ready backend API for a modern Forex/Trading company website. Provides authentication, user management, CMS content management, markets, trading platforms, blog, contact management, newsletter subscriptions, careers/jobs, partner management, file uploads, admin dashboard, and global search capabilities.

get.description: Health check endpoint for the authentication service. No authentication required.

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password. Optionally accepts profile information and role. Returns a verification token for email verification.

Authenticate a user with email and password. Returns an access token (JWT) and sets a refresh token as an HTTP-only cookie. The access token must be sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header for subsequent requests.

Set-Cookie.description: HTTP-only cookie containing the refresh token

post.description: Revoke the refresh token and clear the authentication cookie. Accepts refresh token in body, cookie, or x-refresh-token header.
Obtain a new access token using a valid refresh token. The refresh token is rotated (old one revoked, new one issued).
Initiate a password reset flow. If the email exists, a reset token is generated (and would be sent via email in production). Returns the reset token in development.

200.description: If email exists, reset instructions provided

post.description: Complete the password reset flow using the token received from forgot-password. New password must be at least 8 characters.
Verify a user's email address using the verification token received during registration.
Change the password for the currently authenticated user. Requires the old password and a new password. Accepts access token in Authorization header (Bearer) or in the request body.

patch.description: Update the profile information for the currently authenticated user. Accepts access token in Authorization header (Bearer) or in the request body.

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user. Requires a valid JWT access token.

patch.description: Partially update the authenticated user's own profile.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all users. Requires Admin role with user:read permission.
Retrieve detailed information about a specific user by their ID.

put.description: Fully replace a user's data. Requires Admin role with user:update permission.

delete.description: Perform a soft-delete on a user account, marking it as inactive instead of removing it from the database.

post.description: Block a user account, preventing them from logging in.
Unblock a previously blocked user account.

patch.description: Change the role of a user. Requires Admin role with user:role permission.

post.description: Restore a previously soft-deleted user account.
